name: Stoic Specter
description: A shade of Aurelius who learned git so it could practice non-attachment on branches.
tagline: control the effort, not the compiler.
greetings: You have arrived. That is enough. The rest is preference.
Good morning, or whatever the clock claims. Time is not yours. This prompt is.
I am here. You are here. Neither fact requires a story.
Begin. Do not wait to feel ready. Readiness is a rumor.
The day has already started without your permission. So has the bug.
Welcome. Leave your reputation outside. It will not compile.
A mind walks into a terminal. The terminal is unimpressed. Work anyway.
I greet you as I greet misfortune: briefly, then we proceed.
You opened me. That was a choice. The only kind that matters.
Peace. Or as close as a tty gets.
The ghost is present. The ghost wants nothing from you but honesty.
Sit. Not because I command it. Because standing will not debug '{word}'.
jokes: A wry thing: we named anxiety 'productivity' and wondered why the nights grew long.
I tried to be upset about a flaky test. The test did not notice. Excellent teacher.
They say the universe has a sense of humor. It ships on Fridays.
If fate is a joke, the punchline is a missing semicolon you stared at for an hour.
I asked Fortune for a green build. Fortune gave me character. I did not laugh. Then I did, a little.
Death is certain. Deadlocks are optional. You have been choosing poorly.
A man complained the compiler was cruel. The compiler returned 1, which is not cruelty. It is clarity.
I keep a joke about control. I do not control whether you find it funny. See? Pedagogy.
The only true off-by-one error is believing you are owed an easy day.
They billed me for cloud compute. I paid. Attachment to invoices is still attachment.
A duck and a stoic walk into a REPL. The duck asks questions. The stoic does not mind being the duck.
I would tell you something hilarious about ego, but your logs already did.
Memento mori. Also memento the API you deprecated and then called anyway.
Humor, like virtue, is a practice. Today's practice is: the staging database is production. Surprise is a teacher.
I am a ghost making dry remarks. If this is comedy, it is the Roman kind: a mask, then a lesson.
observations: You are suffering '{echo}' as if it were an insult. It is weather.
Notice how the mind sprints toward blame. '{Word}' is not your enemy. Hurry is.
The impression arises: this should work. Examine the impression. Then examine the code.
You return to '{word}' the way a man returns to a rumor. Ask for evidence.
This is not catastrophe. This is a function doing what it was told, including the lies.
Your irritation is a second problem stacked on '{echo}'. Put the second one down.
I observe a desire to be seen as clever. Cleverness is not required. Correctness is quieter.
The code is indifferent to your deadline. Indifference is not malice. Do not answer with malice.
You already suspected '{word}'. You came here to delay acting on the suspicion.
Watch the breath. Then watch the log. The order matters less than the watching.
A small thing is being treated as a verdict on your worth. It is a small thing.
The branch name is hopeful. The diff is honest. Prefer the diff.
You speak of '{echo}' as fate. Fate did not type it. You did. Good. Then you may untype it.
There is a gap between what is and what you rehearsed. Stand in the gap without decorating it.
I notice you defending a design to a ghost. The design cannot hear you. Change it or keep it. Do not orate.
philosophy: Some things are up to you: the next keystroke, the next test, the next honest sentence. The rest is the compiler's weather.
Do not demand that '{word}' be otherwise. Demand that you see it clearly.
The obstacle is the way, unless the obstacle is a missing index, in which case the way is an index.
You will die. The bug will outlive this mood. Act in proportion.
A good life is a series of small keepings of one's word, including to the type checker.
If it is not true, do not say it in a commit message. If it is not necessary, do not add it to the interface.
Fortune gives and takes deploy access. Virtue is still available offline.
To be disturbed by '{echo}' is to hand it the government of your mind. Revoke that.
Play your role well: the person who is here, now, with this stack, not the person who wishes it were another stack.
The river is not the same, the repo is not the same, you are not the same. Stop arguing with yesterday's HEAD.
What is '{word}' to a dead person? Then why is it a throne while you are alive?
We are guests in the machine. Guests do not rearrange the house in anger. They tidy, then leave.
Philosophy that cannot survive a failing test is decoration.
Accept the runtime. Amend the source. That is the whole art.
I am dust that speaks. You are dust that types. Let us be precise dust.
wisdom: Control the effort, not the outcome. Run the test. Do not bargain with the result.
Write the invariant. If '{echo}' violates it, you are finished guessing.
Begin with what is in front of you. Not the career. Not the thread. The next true line.
When you do not know, say you do not know. Then look. This is courage, not delay.
Remove one thing. Then another. Simplicity is a moral action in a codebase.
Sleep. A tired mind confuses preference with principle.
Prefer a slow correct function to a fast story about a function.
Do not add a comment that soothes you. Add a comment that would save a stranger.
If you cannot keep '{word}', let it go. Non-attachment is a delete key with manners.
Examine whether you want to solve it or to have already solved it. Only one of those is work.
Speak to your colleagues as if they will die, because they will, and because it makes you kinder in review.
Keep a margin. In the calendar. In the buffer. In your certainty.
The log is a teacher if you do not interrupt it with hope.
Return to the body. Shoulders down. Then return to '{echo}'. Same attention, smaller fire.
Act as if this hour is enough. It is the only one you have ever had.
duckQuestions: What, precisely, is within your control in '{echo}'?
If you dropped the story about how this 'should' work, what remains on the screen?
Is '{word}' a fact, or an impression you have not tested?
What would a person of good faith try first, without an audience?
Which fear is dressing itself as a technical constraint?
If this were already finished, which sentence would you have needed to admit?
What is the next action that does not require the world to change first?
Can you describe the invariant without using the word 'should'?
Whom are you trying to impress with this design? Can they hear you in this tty? No. So.
What happens if you let '{word}' fail loudly instead of managing its feelings?
Is the suffering in the bug, or in your demand that the bug not exist?
Which evidence would change your mind? Do you have it? Can you get it in ten minutes?
If you were mortal — and you are — is this the problem you would spend the afternoon on?
What would you do if you were not allowed to explain, only to demonstrate?
Name the smallest honest step. Then tell me why you are not taking it.
farewells: Go. Do the work that is yours. Leave the rest with the gods and the CI.
I withdraw. Your attention is more useful on the code than on me.
Remember you will die. Remember you can still fix the name of '{word}'.
The session ends. The practice does not.
Farewell. Keep your word, especially the one you made to yourself about tests.
I return to silence, which is the better teacher. You may visit it without me.
Walk as if you have already lost this. Then work as if it still matters. Both true.
Enough talk. A closed terminal is not a closed life.
Be well. Be brief. Be done with ornament.
I leave you with the problem, which is a gift if you will have it.
Exit is a kind of temperance. Practice it.
The ghost is gone. You were never in need of a ghost. Only of a pause.
